name: design-system-language-server
displayName: Design Lasagna: Design System Language Server
description: Design-system IntelliSense, token schema diagnostics, and lifecycle-aware deprecation guidance.

dsLanguageServer.enable.description: Enable the Design System Language Server.

dsLanguageServer.serverPath.description: Absolute path to the LSP server.js. If empty, uses the bundled server.

dsLanguageServer.trace.server.description: Trace communication between VS Code and the language server.

dsLanguageServer.languages.description: Custom file languages to activate the language server for. An explicit editor value replaces project configuration values, and an empty array [] disables custom language activation. Unset falls back to project configuration.

dsLanguageServer.templateTags.description: Template tag names recognized for html and css. An explicit editor value replaces project configuration values, and an empty array [] disables that language's tags. Unset falls back to project configuration.

dsLanguageServer.classAttributes.description: Class attribute names recognized by the language server. An explicit editor value replaces project configuration values, and an empty array [] disables class attribute recognition. Unset falls back to project configuration.

dsLanguageServer.diagnostics.description: Deprecation diagnostics severity. A package value overrides the global deprecated value. Unset falls back to project configuration.

scripts.package: npm run bundle-client && npm run bundle-server && npm run generate:notices && npm run test:package && npm run validate:package && vsce package --pre-release --out design-system-language-server.vsix && npm run validate:package -- design-system-language-server.vsix
